listenings.text: Hello, and welcome to SecureNet videos. Today: how to update your firewall. First, open the dashboard. Then click Settings. Don't turn off the firewall. Click Update, and wait five minutes. Don't close the window. At the end, restart the firewall. That's it. Thank you for watching.

Hi Diogo, it's Ravi. I have the steps for your users. Ask them to open the VPN app and click Settings. Then they check the server name. Please tell them: don't change the port number. After that, restart the computer and log in again. If it doesn't work, call me.

reading.rtitle: VPN Not Connecting? Follow These Steps
paras: Your users can't connect to the VPN? Don't worry. Follow these steps. First, check the cable or the Wi-Fi. Then open the VPN app and click Settings.
Check the server name. Don't change the port number: it is 443. Click Update to install the new version of the app. Don't close the window during the update.
Restart the computer and log in again. Still no connection? Check the firewall: don't turn it off, but send us a screenshot. Then call our support team with your ticket number.
